spec.command: cd artifacts/exp005_noise_propagation && nohup .venv/bin/python run_noise_propagation_v3.py --output-dir output_v3 --base-seed 42 --n-seeds 5 > exp005_v3.log 2>&1 &
spec.note: v3: Stan output on local disk, analytic ME model (1231 params vs 10231), simple-first then ME, checkpoint resume support, chain CSV cleanup after each fit. 5 sigma_e levels x 5 seeds x 2 models = 50 fits. ETA ~11-12 hours (Simple ~125min, Analytic ME ~575min)
